card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 15 Pro That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 15 Pro That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 15 Pro / Pro Max Sensor Array: 0x200000 (2097152) = proximity flex; 0x300000 or 0x100000 = charging port flex; 0x400000 = wireless charging flex on back glass.
0x600000 = prox + wireless charging; 0x700000 = charging port + wireless charging.
0xa1 (161) = battery data issue; restarts every 3 minutes; check connector pins, battery and connector voltage.

procedure: Test the flagged flex(es) with known-good OEM parts; diode-check FPCs.
For 0xa1 check battery connector, try a known-good battery, check connector voltage.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Prox / charge port / wireless charging flex / battery
